issues.description: viewport_texture_id() method marked as 'legacy' but remains for UI compatibility. The documentation correctly states this is for compatibility and that the frame graph manages the actual texture. This is appropriate as a transitionary API.

summary: The verify-migration-completeness feature has been successfully implemented and verified. The worker conducted a thorough review of the viewport migration to frame graph approach, confirming that: (1) All old viewport rendering code has been removed (render_viewport, ViewportRenderTarget, rendering state from Viewport struct), (2) Public API remains unchanged (ViewportBuilder pattern still works, ViewportPass exported), (3) Documentation updated to reflect frame graph architecture, (4) All 28 viewport tests passing, (5) No compilation warnings in viewport-related code. The worker appropriately documented deviations from verification steps (performance comparison requires baseline data not available, full workspace test timeout) and used targeted viewport tests instead. No blocking issues found. One non-blocking note about viewport_texture_id() being marked as 'legacy' but appropriately retained for UI compatibility with clear documentation.
